name: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc.
moat_justification: Best-in-class unit economics and proven pricing power, but no switching costs or network effects and a demonstrated food-safety/traffic tail risk.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Elite fast-casual operator, moat 6/10, net cash — but at $30.35 the price already pays for a full margin recovery: weighted IRR 9.6% (Tier D), weighted IV@15% $16.06; clears 15% only below ~$16.
moat_for: Brand and pricing power proven over two decades of through-cycle compounding
Best-in-class unit economics (~$3.1M AUV, ~60% second-year cash-on-cash returns, ~2-year payback)
Digital + loyalty scale (38.3% of Q2 2026 sales digital, ~21M active Rewards members)
Chipotlane format advantage — ~80% of new stores, higher volumes and margins
Company-owned model: full control of quality/throughput, no franchisee friction
moat_against: No switching costs or network effects — every lunch is a fresh choice
Intense fast-casual/QSR competition (CAVA, Sweetgreen, QSR value wars)
Food-safety tail risk (2015 E. coli precedent; 2026 Cyclospora scare cost ~200bp of comp traffic)
Wage/beef inflation with deliberately limited pricing power near term
Path from ~4,200 to 7,000 North American stores at historical returns is unproven
